photos.desc: Soška nalezená v roce 1896 v Isturitz ve Francii. Později byla ztracena. Toto je kresba podle kresby podle fotky. Soška pochází někdy z pozdního pleistocénu a jedná se pravděpodobně o zobrazení mládět
Skeletons (top) and life restorations (bottom) of Smilodon (left) and Homotherium (right)
Fossil of Homotherium - Took the picture at Museum of Natural History, Rotterdam
Fossil of Homotherium - Took the picture at Natural History Museum, Mainz
Illustration of Homotherium latidens in life, depicted with the white tufty "beard" known from the permafrost mummy cub.
Fachada del Natural History Museum (Museo de Historia Natural) de Londres (Inglaterra, Reino Unido).
Life-sized model of a prehistoric saber-toothed cat (Homotherium) on a rock in the permanent exhibition "Windows into Prehistory" (Okna do pravěku) at the National Museum in Prague.
